questions.stem: What is the name given to the curves obtained by intersecting a right circular cone by a plane?
questions.solution: The general term for the curves formed by intersecting a right circular cone with a plane is conic sections. This term encompasses all possible curves, including parabolas, ellipses, and hyperbolas, which are specific types of conic sections. The other options refer to individual types of curves, not the overall classification.

questions.stem: What is the term used for the line segment joining the two foci of a hyperbola?
questions.solution: The line segment joining the two foci of a hyperbola is called the transverse axis. The conjugate axis is the line through the centre and perpendicular to the transverse axis. The terms major and minor axes are used for ellipses, not hyperbolas.

questions.stem: What is the term used for the fixed points in a hyperbola?
questions.solution: The fixed points in a hyperbola are called the foci. The vertices are the points where the hyperbola intersects the transverse axis. The center is the midpoint of the line segment joining the foci, and the axes are the lines that define the orientation of the hyperbola.

questions.stem: Which of the following is a conic section that is formed when a plane intersects the cone at an angle β = 90 degrees?
questions.solution: A circle is formed when a plane intersects a cone at a right angle (β = 90 degrees), as this results in a perfectly symmetrical cross-section. An ellipse is formed when the plane is tilted slightly, a parabola when it is parallel to the cone's side, and a hyperbola when it cuts through both nappes of the cone.

questions.stem: What is the definition of a parabola?
choices: A parabola is the set of all points in a plane that are equidistant from a fixed line and a fixed point.

questions.solution: The definition of a parabola is the set of all points in a plane that are equidistant from a fixed line (directrix) and a fixed point (focus). The other options describe different geometric shapes or concepts, such as a circle or a line, and are not correct.

questions.stem: If the distance between the two foci of a hyperbola is 10 units, what is the value of 'c'?
questions.solution: The distance between the two foci of a hyperbola is 2c. If this distance is 10 units, then 2c = 10, so c = 5. The other options are either double or more than double the actual value.

questions.stem: Which of the following represents the equation of an ellipse centered at the origin with major axis along the x-axis and semi-major axis length 4 and semi-minor axis length 3?
questions.solution: The standard form of an ellipse centered at the origin with major axis along the x-axis is x²/a² + y²/b² = 1, where a is the semi-major axis and b is the semi-minor axis. Here, a = 4 and b = 3, so the equation is x²/16 + y²/9 = 1. The other options either switch a and b or use the original values instead of their squares.

hi.stem: निम्नलिखित में से कौन एक ऐसे दीर्घवृत्त के समीकरण का प्रतिनिधित्व करता है जो मूल बिंदु पर केंद्रित है, जिसका दीर्घ अक्ष x-अक्ष के साथ है और दीर्घ अर्धअक्ष की लंबाई 4 और लघु अर्धअक्ष की लंबाई 3 है?
hi.solution: मूल बिंदु पर केंद्रित एक दीर्घवृत्त के मानक रूप में x²/a² + y²/b² = 1 होता है, जहां a दीर्घ अर्धअक्ष है और b लघु अर्धअक्ष है। यहां, a = 4 और b = 3 है, इसलिए समीकरण x²/16 + y²/9 = 1 है। अन्य विकल्प या तो a और b को बदल देते हैं या मूल मानों का उपयोग करते हैं बजाय उनके वर्गों के।

questions.stem: A circle with radius 5 has its centre on the x-axis and passes through the point (2, 3). What is the equation of the circle?
questions.solution: The equation of a circle is (x - h)² + (y - k)² = r², where (h, k) is the center and r is the radius. Since the center is on the x-axis, k = 0. Using the distance formula between (h, 0) and (2, 3), we find h = 4, making the equation (x - 4)² + y² = 25. The other options either have incorrect centers or do not satisfy the distance requirement for the radius.

hi.stem: 5 त्रिज्या वाला एक वृत्त जिसका केंद्र x-अक्ष पर है और बिंदु (2, 3) से गुजरता है। वृत्त का समीकरण क्या है?
hi.solution: वृत्त का समीकरण (x - h)² + (y - k)² = r² होता है, जहाँ (h, k) केंद्र है और r त्रिज्या है। केंद्र x-अक्ष पर है, इसलिए k = 0। (h, 0) और (2, 3) के बीच दूरी के सूत्र का उपयोग करके, हम पाते हैं कि h = 4, जिसके कारण समीकरण (x - 4)² + y² = 25 होता है। अन्य विकल्प या गलत केंद्र का उपयोग करते हैं या त्रिज्या की दूरी की आवश्यकता को पूरा नहीं करते।
hi.critique: Translation is accurate and maintains mathematical meaning, technical terms, and logical structure.
